_comment: Drives the amber 'Recently updated' dots in the homepage nav. Written by scripts/stamp-nav-dots.py, checked in CI. A dot older than window_days is dropped automatically, so a marker cannot sit on a nav item forever the way the two hardcoded ones did (added 2026-07-29 and never revisited, while the blog — which had the two newest posts on the site — carried none).

nav-blog.why: the blog gains posts most often, so a hand-maintained date here is the one guaranteed to rot
